patch_list: Ad-Free and Remove Upgrade Nags - MacroDroid (Experimental)
Removes banner and interstitial advertisements, disables Pro upgrade nag screens (AdvertActivity, MacroDroidProAdvertActivity2), and suppresses rewarded advert prompts across MacroDroid.
Allow Screenshots and Scenes Capture - MacroDroid (Experimental)
Removes FLAG_SECURE window flags from MacroDroid password prompts, variable value dialogs, and custom scene screens, permitting screen captures and screen recording without black screen blocking.
Removes the free-tier restriction limiting users to 5 macros. Enables creating, running, and importing an unlimited number of active automation macros and action blocks.
Unlock Pro and Unlimited Features - MacroDroid (Experimental)
Bypasses Google Play Billing verification for MacroDroid Pro, unlocks all Pro-exclusive actions, triggers, and constraints, and enables full automation features without restriction.
